nodes.n: 6:50 AM. Kabir Sir's office is a shipping container behind net six. He doesn't offer you a chair.

nodes.t: Twenty-two years ago a man like Mehra bought my opening partner. I knew. I said nothing. He played forty Tests. I opened a coaching academy.
I've regretted it every day since. I'm not doing it twice.
You're on the plane. Not because of the tunnel. Because of net three. Don't make me regret that as well.
Shaikh's on the plane too. Tell him before I do. He'll cry. I don't do crying.
The OTHER HALF OF THE BOAT, BHAI!
Shaikh isn't fit. Standby list. If he heals, he flies in. You did that for him, by the way. He doesn't know it yet.
Shaikh's on the plane. He's limping when he thinks I'm not looking. Is there something I should know?
Hm. Then I'll watch him myself.
Physio. Now. He'll hate you. He'll also still be bowling in ten years.

nodes.n: Press conference. Forty cameras. The squad is read out in alphabetical order. Your name is eleventh. Somebody's flash goes off right in your eyes.
First question. Not for the captain. For you.
"Is it true you're close to Raghav Mehra? Is that why you're on this list?"

choice.t: "I made mistakes at nineteen. I never fixed a ball."
"Ask Raghav Mehra why he's so interested in me."
choice.d: Throw it back at him. Live on TV.

nodes.n: The room moves on. The cameras don't.
The room goes silent. Then forty phones start typing at once. Next to you, Karan stares at the table so he doesn't smile.

msgs.t: There's a black car outside the stall since morning. Two men. Just sitting.
They ordered chai. Papa served them. They didn't drink it.

nodes.cliff: Mehra's men aren't watching you anymore. They're watching Papa.
